param.label: Minimum epochs
param.help: Minimum number of epochs to train for when using early stopping.

param.name: lag
param.label: Early stopping lag
param.help: Number of evaluations to wait for improvement in the validation score before stopping training.

param.name: min_delta
param.label: Minimum validation improvement
param.help: Minimum improvement in the validation score required to reset early stopping.

param.name: epochs
param.label: Epochs
param.help: Number of epochs to train for.

param.label: Learning rate warmup
param.help: Number of steps to linearly ramp the learning rate from zero to the initial learning rate.

param.label: Cosine maximum
param.help: Epoch at which the cosine learning rate schedule reaches its minimum learning rate.

param.label: Step size
param.help: Number of validation runs between learning rate decay steps.

param.label: Scheduler patience
param.help: Number of validation runs to wait before reducing the learning rate.

param.label: Learning rate scheduler
param.help: AdamW + Muon supports only cosine and constant learning rate schedules.

param.label: Learning rate warmup
param.help: Number of steps to linearly ramp the learning rate from zero to the initial learning rate.

param.label: Unicode normalization
param.help: Normalize ground-truth transcriptions using the selected Unicode normalization form. If unset, no Unicode normalization is applied.

param.name: normalize_whitespace
param.label: Normalize whitespace
param.help: Normalize Unicode whitespace characters in the ground truth to U+0020 SPACE.

param.name: reorder
param.label: Bidirectional text reordering
param.help: Reorder ground-truth code points according to the Unicode bidirectional algorithm.

param.label: Base text direction
param.help: Set the base text direction used for bidirectional reordering. Auto uses direction information from the input data when available.

param.label: Line padding
param.help: Padding in pixels around the start and end of each line image.

param.name: legacy_polygons
param.label: Use legacy polygon extraction
param.help: Use the slower legacy polygon extractor for training.
